evals.prompt: Find me 5 VP Engineering prospects at Series B SaaS companies with strong headcount growth. We're Rivela — we help engineering teams manage data pipelines at scale, cutting incident response time by 60%. My name is Sarah Chen, Head of Sales at Rivela. Draft cold emails for each.
evals.expected_output: A table of 5 companies with their growth signals, one verified VP Engineering contact per company, enriched emails, and 5 Gmail drafts created. Each draft opener references the specific headcount growth signal found for that company. A CSV tracker is written to the outputs folder.
expectations: Asks clarifying questions if ICP details are missing before searching
Uses crustdata_company_enrich to score companies by headcount growth signals
Selects companies with QoQ headcount growth > 15% or recent funding as priority
Uses crustdata_people_search_db to find VP Engineering (not CEO) at each company
Batches crustdata_people_enrich calls with fields: name,business_email,personal_contact_info.personal_emails
Each email opener references a specific company signal (e.g. '38% headcount growth QoQ'), not a generic template
Does not use the same opener pattern twice across the 5 drafts
Creates Gmail drafts using gmail_create_draft for each prospect with a found email
Logs all prospects to a CSV tracker including those with no email found
Marks prospects without email as status: no_contact in the tracker

evals.prompt: I want to reach out to engineering leaders at companies that recently raised Series A or B. We sell developer tooling for observability. Target CTOs or VPs of Engineering at companies with 20–100 employees. Give me 5 prospects and draft emails. I'm Priya Nair, Founder at Optica.
evals.expected_output: Finds 5 recently funded companies (Series A/B in the last 6 months), identifies CTO or VP Engineering at each, enriches emails, and creates 5 Gmail drafts. Email openers reference the recent funding round as the trigger, not generic pain.
expectations: Uses crustdata_web_search to discover recently funded Series A/B companies in the dev tools / engineering space
Uses crustdata_company_enrich to confirm funding stage and headcount range (20–100 employees)
Identifies CTO for companies under 50 employees, VP Engineering for companies 50–100
Uses crustdata_people_search_db with title filters to find the right person
Email openers reference the recent funding as a buying signal (e.g., 'Saw you raised Series A last month')
Falls back to GitHub commit history for technical contacts missing email after Crustdata enrichment
Creates Gmail drafts for all prospects with verified emails
Writes CSV tracker to outputs folder with company_signal column filled in for each row

evals.prompt: I have a list of target companies: LinearB, Cortex, Swimlane, Rootly, FireHydrant. Find the Head of Engineering or VP Engineering at each, get their emails, and draft a personalized cold email for each. We're Signalfire (not the VC) — we help incident management teams reduce MTTR. I'm James Okafor, Account Executive.
evals.expected_output: Enriches each of the 5 named companies for growth signals, finds the right engineering leader at each, enriches emails, and creates 5 Gmail drafts. Each email opener is different and references something specific to that company.
expectations: Uses crustdata_company_enrich on all 5 domains to pull growth signals before searching for contacts
Uses crustdata_people_search_db with company name and title filters to find Head/VP Engineering at each
Batches all 5 LinkedIn URLs into a single crustdata_people_enrich call
Identifies a unique signal per company from enrichment data (headcount growth, traffic, funding)
Each of the 5 email openers references a different signal — no two openers use the same template
Subject line follows [SenderCompany] x [TargetCompany] format or signal-based format
Creates Gmail drafts for all prospects with found emails
Logs status for all 5 to CSV tracker, including any where email was not found

evals.prompt: Find me data engineering or ML platform leads at AI startups in the US that have been growing fast. We sell vector database tooling. Target companies between 30–150 employees. I need 5 prospects. I'm Amir Hosseini, Founder at VectraDB.
evals.expected_output: Discovers 5 US-based AI startups with fast headcount or web traffic growth, finds the right ML/data engineering decision-maker (not always VP — could be Head of ML or Staff Data Engineer at smaller companies), enriches emails, and creates Gmail drafts referencing AI-specific growth signals.
expectations: Uses crustdata_web_search to discover fast-growing US AI startups in the 30–150 employee range
Scores companies by headcount or web traffic growth signals
Identifies ML/Data/Platform leads rather than defaulting to VP Engineering — adjusts title search based on company size and domain
Uses crustdata_people_search_db with ML/Data/AI title keywords
Each email opener is specific to the company's growth signal and relevant to vector DB pain (e.g. 'scaling embedding workloads')
Batches email enrichment across all 5 contacts
Creates Gmail drafts and logs to CSV tracker
